description: This file contains unit tests for the class DetailedLeaveRequest in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing leave request details, date calculations, and allowed actions within the Leave module. It uses PHPUnit testing framework and mocks dependencies for isolated testing.

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequestTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the DetailedLeaveRequest class testing various scenarios of leave request details and date computations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data by loading fixture YAML file before each test.

methods.name: testEmptyLeaveRequest
methods.description: Verifies that accessing uninitialized properties raises errors, and setting empty leaves throws exceptions.

methods.name: testSingleDayLeaveRequest
methods.description: Checks details of a single-day leave request, including dates and duration type.

methods.name: testMultiDayLeaveRequestFirstDayHoliday
methods.description: Tests leave request spanning multiple days with the first day being a holiday, and verifies allowed actions.

methods.name: testMultiStatusLeaveRequest
methods.description: Validates leave request with multiple statuses and checks that no actions are allowed.

methods.name: setServices
methods.description: Sets up mocked services and dependencies required for the leave request tests.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodsWithAssignedLeaveForPastLeavePeriod
methods.description: Ensures that leave periods retrieval correctly handles past leave periods with assigned leave.
